verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires editable customer-specific report fields and identifies the values that must be updateable.
The client directly refines how the editable assessment date and vehicle identity fields should be presented.
The generic design-update claim does not identify this Requirement in its source text and depends on a broad multi-requirement instruction message for target meaning.
First concrete failure: the delivered date field displays duplicated placeholder text instead of a clean editable date value or placeholder.
